00047 void UnaryNegUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw() 
00048 { 
00049   const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize(); 
00050   float* const outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData(); 
00051   const float* const inputSamples = inputs[Operand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00052   VFP::neg16(inputSamples, outputSamples, numSamplesToProcess);
00053 }
